shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,260p' app/product/page.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' lib/data.ts && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -print | sort && git status --short && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc 'artifact_dir=$(mktemp -d)
mv /workspace/.next "$artifact_dir/next-build-output"
git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- app/product/page.tsx tsconfig.json'
